choices: A model that is too slow to train
A model that performs well on training data but poorly on new, unseen data
Training a model with too little data
A model with too few parameters to capture patterns
explanation: Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes training data noise rather than learning generalizable patterns. Signs: very high training accuracy, low test accuracy. Mitigations: more training data, regularization (dropout, L2), cross-validation, simpler models.
